items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: I went up to San Antonio and worked with him a while... I worked with him in San Antonio about four months.

ctx.x: And that's all he played. He'd take the numbers off the stocks and arranger them. He didn't want to play those stocks. He didn't want those stocks on the bandstand.
What about a boot? Didn't some of those guys play with boots and his buddies? Boots and his buddies?

That's he. He about know them. That's when I said they told him. You did? Oh, I went up to San Antonio and worked with him a while. Yeah, boy. Yeah. He was a drummer, wasn't he? Huh? Was he a drummer? Yeah. Yeah. He come to El Paso. Oh, I worked with him in San Antonio about four months. And then it got on it, man, about them young Mexican girls there, man. Oh, I see. So, man, he messed up some girls there. Oh, no. He had to leave there. No wonder he's out of El Paso. And I got out before they, before they,…
